detectors.name: LLM -- Response Length Anomaly
detectors.description: Detects sudden changes in LLM response length distribution that may indicate model drift, prompt regression, or upstream API changes.
detectors.programText:
from signalfx.detectors.against_recent import against_recent
A = data('gen_ai.client.response.length', filter=filter('service.name', 'rag-api')).mean()
against_recent.detector_mean_std(stream=A, current_window='15m', historical_window='1d', fire_num_stddev=3, clear_num_stddev=2.5, orientation='both').publish('Response Length Anomaly')

detectors.name: LLM -- Output Token Anomaly
detectors.description: Detects sudden changes in output token consumption that may indicate model verbosity changes or prompt issues.
detectors.programText:
from signalfx.detectors.against_recent import against_recent
A = data('gen_ai.client.token.count', filter=filter('gen_ai.token.type', 'output') and filter('service.name', 'rag-api')).mean()
against_recent.detector_mean_std(stream=A, current_window='15m', historical_window='1d', fire_num_stddev=3, clear_num_stddev=2.5, orientation='both').publish('Output Token Anomaly')

detectors.name: LLM -- Latency Anomaly
detectors.description: Detects sudden changes in LLM call latency that may indicate model swaps, API throttling, or infrastructure issues.
detectors.programText:
from signalfx.detectors.against_recent import against_recent
A = data('traces.span.metrics.duration', filter=filter('service.name', 'rag-api') and filter('gen_ai.operation.name', 'chat'), rollup='average').mean()
against_recent.detector_mean_std(stream=A, current_window='15m', historical_window='1d', fire_num_stddev=3, clear_num_stddev=2.5, orientation='above').publish('Latency Anomaly')
